The Ancient Amulet

Dartas saw an amulet that may open the cave in the Two Rivers valley. A village elder near Dar-Leanos found it. Harpies have since overrun the village, probably because of the amulet.

Objectives

Go to the village

Take the amulet

Locations

Maps
Dar-Leanos and its surroundings

Authored rewards

PropertyValue
